notes: Stack of four fingerpost blades under the Eskişehir Büyükşehir Belediyesi logo on Cengiz Topel Blvd: yellow Köprübaşı (City Center) left, orange Vilayet / Büyükşehir Bld. author: Kıvırcıklüleler
attribution: Photo: Kıvırcıklüleler, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ayd%C4%B1n_Sokak_Tabelas%C4%B1.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue enamel numbered-street plate, Kuşadası (Aydın province), frontal. Turkish format: municipality header, mahalle (neighbourhood) name, street number + SOKAK, and 'TN:' = tabela numarası (sign number) 43 with a direction arrow. Glare covers the 'LE' of BELEDİYESİ; 'AYDIN' has dotless capital I as expected, other capitals are dotted İ. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Bernard Gagnon

notes: Diamond-shaped World Heritage site board in a wooden frame at Hattusa (Boğazkale, Çorum). 'Mirasi' is printed with a dotted i (standard Turkish would be Mirası); transcribed as printed. UNESCO and World Heritage emblems at top and bottom are not text targets. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
